code:
-- NEVER matches NULL rows, on ANY platform in this course
SELECT * FROM Customers WHERE MiddleName = NULL;   -- wrong

-- Correct, universal way
SELECT * FROM Customers WHERE MiddleName IS NULL;   -- right
caption: = NULL never matches anywhere -- the one truly portable NULL rule.
'' and NULL are genuinely different, distinct values here.
Oracle stores '' as NULL in VARCHAR2 -- documented, not a bug.
